defect: ListColumnReader::Read now calls child_result.Reset() on entry, which resets data[1] (the overflow slice carried over from the previous call) from its vector cache, so the carried-over child values are lost and garbage is appended to the next lists.
reason: The fix replaces the two-vector DataChunk with a fresh per-iteration vector and a separate overflow_read_vector member that is never reset, repairing the overflow handling this change introduced; that Reset() re-initialises every column is in data_chunk.cpp.

defect: InspectTableFilters now casts every LogicalGet's bind_data to TableScanBindData and calls get->function.statistics unconditionally (then dereferences the result), so scans such as arrow_scan without that bind data or statistics callback segfault.
reason: The fix guards exactly these added lines (bind_data check, skip arrow_scan); before the change a get without a catalog table returned early.

defect: The fix changes how many padding bytes are handed to string prefixes (bytes_to_fill); the change's entry_size % 8 is the wrong count, but entry_size is aligned with AlignValue afterwards in every path.
reason: The miscount only changes how much string prefix is inlined versus padded (row width), with no misalignment, wrong result or crash, so the fix tunes a layout heuristic rather than repairing a correctness defect.

defect: The new rule rewrites a * 0 and 0 / a to the constant 0, which is wrong when a is NULL (the result must be NULL).
reason: The fix removes exactly these two rewrites added by this change, citing NULL semantics.

defect: The new header includes add.hpp, multiply.hpp and subtract.hpp by bare relative names instead of duckdb/common/operator/..., which the amalgamation build cannot resolve.
reason: The fix (fix for amalg) rewrites exactly these include lines added by the change; the amalgamation is a supported build.

defect: HashInternal hashes with the selection vector, which writes hashes at the selected row indices into a vector sized approved_tuple_count (out of bounds) while LookupHashes reads the dense positions 0..count, giving crashes and wrong filter results.
reason: The fix removes this sel branch added by the change; that VectorOperations::Hash with a selection writes at the selected indices is in vector_hash.cpp.

defect: JoinElimination keeps a single join_parent/left_child/right_child, so a second comparison join seen by the same visitor overwrites the first join's child state (D_ASSERT in debug, and sibling joins are evaluated with the wrong child's distinct groups and filters).
reason: The fix replaces these members added by the change with a per-join vector of JoinEliminationStat; the misuse is visible only in join_elimination.cpp.

defect: The new can_add check looks up projection output bindings (projection.table_index, idx) in a distinct group made of the child's bindings, so it never matches and distinct groups never propagate through projections (e.g. joins on GROUP BY subqueries are no longer eliminated, failing the PR's own test).
reason: The fix rewrites exactly this check to track which child column ids the projection references; both binding constructions are in the shown hunk.

defect: The change adds LogLevel::ERROR, which collides with the ERROR macro from windows.h and breaks compilation on Windows.
reason: The fix renames the value to RECOVERABLE_ERROR in this generated line (and in logger.hpp); the clash exists since this change introduced the enum.

defect: Replacing cached_chunk.Reset() with SetCardinality(0) keeps the cached chunk's validity masks from earlier appends, so stale NULLs leak into later cached join output (#2102).
reason: The fix restores Reset() in exactly these two lines; that SetCardinality does not clear the null mask needs DataChunk/Append semantics from other files.

defect: The import-cache item for pyduckdb.Value is created with attribute name value instead of Value, so the attribute lookup on the module fails.
reason: The removed code loaded Value; the fix restores the correct name in the line this change added.

defect: bind_quantile now pops the quantile argument, so quantile(x, 0.1) and quantile(x, 0.9) differ only in bind_data, which aggregate equality ignores (FunctionData::Equals defaults to true); the optimizer merges them and returns wrong values.
reason: The fix adds QuantileBindData::Equals and the bind_info comparison with a multi-quantile test; the collision exists only since this change removed the argument from the children.

defect: When OR zone-map pushdown is judged not worthwhile, CheckStatisticsWithCardinality returns FILTER_ALWAYS_FALSE, which makes the statistics propagator replace the scan with an empty result.
reason: The fix changes this added return to FILTER_ALWAYS_TRUE (drop the table filter, keep the original); returning always-false for not-worth-it is wrong on its face.

defect: The rewritten RefineCandidates keeps a candidate when it fails or errors (!!RefineCandidateNextChunk || error), stops after the first kept candidate and keeps finished candidates even with errors, so failing dialects survive and good ones are dropped.
reason: The fix corrects exactly that condition and the break/continue logic added by this change.

defect: BloomFilterState allocates hashes_v, keys_flat_v and bf_sel with a fixed STANDARD_VECTOR_SIZE capacity while Filter writes approved_tuple_count entries into them, overflowing when the count exceeds that capacity.
reason: The fix (seg fault, too small capacity) adds current_capacity and grows the buffers in bloom_filter.hpp; the growth logic survived into the merged JoinFilterTableFilterState.

defect: The row_limit logic declared here (AddRowGroupWithLimit) counts overlapping row groups as qualifying (second clause lacks the stat_type check, every overlap adds one), so the reorderer can stop before row groups that hold top-N rows and ORDER BY ... LIMIT returns wrong rows.
reason: The fix rewrites the declaration and the scan_state.cpp implementation added by the same change; the header alone does not show the faulty logic.

defect: use_limit pushes limit+offset as a row limit into the scan even through aggregates and for NULLS FIRST orders, where the first N base-table rows by row-group statistics do not determine the top-N result.
reason: The fix adds exactly those exclusions to the use_limit decision introduced by this change.

defect: JoinHashTable::Merge checks partition_block_collections.empty() before taking partition_lock and merges into existing partitions without the lock, so concurrent PartitionTasks race (double insertion or merging into a vector still being filled).
reason: The fix takes the lock around the whole check-and-merge that this change added.

defect: The new ANALYZE binding creates one select expression per listed name, including duplicates and generated columns, while get.column_ids and column_id_map hold only distinct stored columns, so projection, map and statistics get out of step (asserts or out-of-range), and an all-generated table yields an empty scan.
reason: The fix rejects duplicates, skips generated columns, maps to StorageOid and handles the empty case, all in code this change introduced; the mismatch depends on BindColumn/CreatePlan behaviour.

defect: PythonFilesystem now stores protocols, name and filesystem as const references to constructor arguments, which dangle once the caller's temporaries are gone.
reason: The fix restores an owned protocols vector and drops the name reference, undoing the reference members this change introduced.

defect: IsObj<yyjson_t>(val) and the other helpers are called with explicit template arguments, so only the throwing primary templates are viable (the non-template overloads are never picked), and the free GetPointerDollar<...> is hidden by the member of the same name; JSON path extraction throws or fails to build.
reason: The fix moves the helpers into the header as explicit template specialisations, repairing the dispatch this change added.

defect: TransformAddColumn reads IF NOT EXISTS from child 1 (the optional COLUMN keyword) instead of child 2, so ADD COLUMN behaves as IF NOT EXISTS and ADD IF NOT EXISTS does not.
reason: The fix changes exactly this index; the child order comes from the PEG grammar file.

defect: The change reverts WriteSecret to writing the secret straight into the final file (delete, then create) instead of a temp file plus move, reintroducing non-atomic secret writes (#13077).
reason: The fix re-applies the temp-file-and-move code that this change removed two minutes after it had been added.

defect: Routing all-NULL arguments to BindListConcat also applies to concat() and ||, so concat(NULL) now returns NULL instead of the empty string.
reason: The fix splits the all_null case by function kind, repairing the routing this change added; before it concat(NULL) went through the string path.

defect: sizeof(2 * sizeof(uint32_t)) is sizeof(size_t), not 8, so on 32-bit builds the offset advances 4 bytes after two 4-byte sizes are stored and the compressed data overwrites the uncompressed size.
reason: The fix replaces both added sizeof expressions with 2 * sizeof(uint32_t); the code only happens to work on 64-bit.

defect: Moving BufferHandles out of temp_scan_state leaves moved-from handles in its map; InitializeChunkState then treats those blocks as already pinned, so later chunks read through invalid handles (#6204).
reason: The fix removes this handle-moving loop and scans with DISALLOW_ZERO_COPY; the already-pinned check is in column_data_allocator.cpp.

defect: The header still declares NumpyToLogicalType(const NumpyNullableType &) while the same change made callers pass the new NumpyType and redefined the function in type.cpp to take NumpyType, so the Python package does not compile.
reason: The fix updates the declaration to take NumpyType; the mismatch is between this header and type.cpp/numpy_bind.cpp changed in the same commit.

defect: Node16::erase calls child[15].release() for a full node, leaking the removed child.
reason: The fix changes release() to reset() in that line added by this change.

defect: ExtractBindings now throws NotImplementedException for any correlated subquery in a filter, and the join order optimizer runs before subquery rewriting, so queries with correlated subqueries (several TPC-H queries) fail.
reason: The fix replaces this throw with a bail-out from reordering (inside a larger rework); before this change such filters were not rejected.

defect: The new low_index, high_index and equal_index flags are left uninitialised, and only the ones a predicate uses get set, so the index scan reads indeterminate bools.
reason: The fix default-initialises exactly these members added by the change.

defect: VerifyBuffers is added as a pure virtual to BoundIndex, so index types in extensions that derive from it and do not implement it become abstract and fail to build.
reason: The fix (fix extension build) makes it a non-pure virtual with a default; seeing the breakage needs the out-of-tree subclasses.

defect: PurgeAgedBlocksInternal's callback returns is_fresh, but IterateUnloadableBlocks stops on false, so it keeps unloading fresh blocks and stops at the first aged one.
reason: The fix negates that return value in the line this change added; the stop-on-false contract is visible in the same diff.

defect: The change adds shared_ptr<DatabaseInstance> db to ColumnDataScanState as its last member and assigns it after clearing handles, so the database can be released before the scan's BufferHandles are destroyed.
reason: The fix (CI failures) moves db first in the struct and assigns it first in InitializeScan; the lifetime order is defined in column_data_scan_states.hpp, added by the same commit.

defect: WriteCopyStatement no longer writes the schema prefix for tables outside main and pairs tables with exported_tables by vector position, so load.sql copies into the wrong table or from the wrong file.
reason: The fix restores the schema prefix and pairs entries through a map, repairing the lines this change rewrote.

defect: PrepareParameters takes the unnamed values by value and the callers std::move the caller's vector and stmt.values into it, consuming parameters that are needed again (re-execution, rebinding).
reason: The fix removes the unnamed-values path from PrepareParameters and stops consuming them in the callers changed by this commit.

defect: TypeHasExactRowCount recurses with kv.second.id(), building a LogicalType from the bare id, so nested struct children lose their child types (#4859).
reason: The fix passes the full type in exactly this added line.

defect: HomeDirectorySetting::SetLocal uses the inverted condition input.IsNull() ? input.ToString() : string(), so setting a home directory stores an empty string.
reason: The fix replaces this added line with input.ToString().

defect: REQUIRE(a && b) without extra parentheses does not compile with Catch (static_assert: operator&& not supported inside assertions), breaking the unittest build.
reason: The fix adds the parentheses to the line this change introduced (and also turns a D_ASSERT into a REQUIRE).

defect: The new INT128 case instantiates TemplatedExecute<int128_t>, a type DuckDB does not define (its 128-bit type is hugeint_t), so the file does not compile.
reason: The fix (wrong type) replaces int128_t with hugeint_t in that line.

defect: A NULL at index 0 stores dictionary.end (an absolute position) instead of 0 as its dictionary offset, so the length of the next string, computed from offset differences, is wrong.
reason: The fix changes this added line to 0; all other entries store the relative dictionary.size.
